events.details: This juried exhibition features creative variations on the traditional holiday decoration in all varieties of materials and subjects. Artists are invited to commemorate the holiday season by handcrafting a whimsical wreath using inventive, unexpected objects. To submit your wreath for consideration, please send a proposal according to the guidelines below. Due to space constraints not all applications can be selected. Entrants will be notified no later than Friday, Nov. 6 about wreath selections. Send your entry soon! RulesWreaths exhibited in or proposed for past Arsenal Gallery shows will not be considered. Wreaths will be hung from gallery molding, not mounted on the wall, so please incorporate loops (above the midpoint of your wreath) in your design. events.title: Forest Fitness
events.description: Explore Fort Tryon Park while you exercise! Join Nancy Bruning for free Fitness at the Fort with walking, stairs, stretching, and nature on Tuesday...
events.details: Join us for a free, year-round \"Fitness at the Fort\" exercise program on Tuesdays, Thursdays, and Saturdays! This fitness class incorporates climbing multiple staircases, stretches and strengthening exercises, notable tree identification, and forest bathing. Led by instructor, Nancy Bruning, BA, MPH, PAPHS. Classes are structured so that all levels of fitness will be accommodated; however, all classes involve relatively brisk walking and some stairs because of the layout of the park itself. Classes vary according to the season, path conditions, and the weather, but always meet at the Heather Garden entrance. Tuesday and Thursday classes end at various points near the starting point, including the volleyball courts. Saturday class ends at the Anne Loftus Playground, using the various pieces of equipment, and offers optional after-class group walk to the Greenmarket on Isham Street. All classes end with closing with stretches. (Note: Fitness Walking does not meet...

events.title: New Dendrology at the Arsenal Gallery
events.description: New Dendrology is a group exhibition featuring eleven artists whose work contributes to the study of trees, offering new insight and connection bet...
events.details: New Dendrology is a group exhibition featuring eleven artists whose work contributes to the study of trees, offering new insight and connection between humans and their arboreal neighbors. From communing with streets trees through a reading with The New York City Street Tree Tarot deck by Matthew López-Jensen, to the commitment ceremonies officiated by Laura Nova , artworks featured in this exhibition invite you to engage in a new kind of relationship with trees. Featured Artist: Mariel Collard, Karin Giusti, Mark Heller, Anya Hoyer, Ekene Ijeoma, Gail Karlsson, sTo Len, Anthoula Lelekidis, Matthew López-Jensen, Amanda Lovelee, and Laura Nova. Image credit: The Bright Oak, 2019, Matthew López-Jensen

events.description: Join NYC Parks staff in free activities in NYC's playgrounds, including organized sports, games, fitness demos, board games, water games, and mor
events.details: \u200BVega, Shayr (Parks)\u200B The Kids in Motion program engages children in active, outdoor play. A NYC Parks staff member leads four to seven hours of free activities in NYC's playgrounds, including organized sports, games, fitness demos, board games, water games, and more! Kias in Motion is a free, drop-in program without registration. Children can head to the playground during the listed hours of operation to participate. Occasionally a Kids in Motion program may be cancelled due to harsh weather or other conditions. Please note: We recommend that guardians accompany children participating in this program. Kids in Motion is not a childcare program and NYC Parks is not responsible for the well-being of attendees.

events.title: Yoga en Español (Yoga in Spanish)
events.description: Conéctate, equilibra y desafíate con Yoga en español.
events.details: Conéctate, equilibra y desafíate con Yoga en español. Esta clase de Vinyasa Yoga incluye flujos de intensidad media que te llevarán desde el saludo al sol hasta una postura máxima final. Ven y concéntrate en las inversiones y la respiración para ayudarte a mejorar tu práctica personal mientras brindas conciencia y una nueva experiencia. Se recomiendan tapetes, pero no son obligatorios, y todos los niveles son bienvenido. Connect, balance, and challenge yourself with Yoga in Spanish. This Vinyasa Yoga class includes mid-intensity flows that will move you seamlessly from sun salutation to a final peak pose. Come focus on inversions and breath work to help improve your personal practice while bringing awareness and a new experience. Mats are recommended but not required and all levels are welcome.

events.title: Ongoing Museum Exhibit: New York's Brick & Terra Cotta Industries
events.description: NYC Parks and the Tottenville Historical Society invite you to visit a unique collection of terracotta artifacts and masonry bricks.
events.details: NYC Parks and the Tottenville Historical Society invite you to visit a unique collection of terracotta artifacts and masonry bricks that chronicle turn-of-the-twentieth-century architectural styles common in New York City and across the United States, and to learn about the area's rich terracotta and brick making tradition, including the famed former Atlantic Terra Cotta Company.

events.description: Join Friends of Shoelace Park for their monthly meetings!
events.details: Join Friends of Shoelace Park for their monthly meetings. The mission of Friends of Shoelace Park is to serve and uplift the surrounding community by providing a space for rest, recreation, and active participation in restoration, beautification, educational, and stewardship opportunities. Our goal is to foster a supportive relationship between the community and the park, where each benefits from the other.

events.description: Using your own body weight, come experience this circuit training class that focuses on functional, everyday movement that will increase overall st...
events.details: Using your own body weight, come experience this circuit training class that focuses on functional, everyday movement that will increase overall strength. This is not just a great workout, but a way to learn \"movement tools\" you can use in everyday life. Open to all fitness levels, and you can expect several rounds of timed exercises followed by rest. Sets and rounds will vary class to class, and all exercises will be demonstrated and cued for participants.
